attempts.text:
Rohan Deshmukh

rohan.deshmukh@example.com | +91 98220 44551 | Pune, Maharashtra 411045

Candidate Snapshot

Backend developer with three years of experience designing APIs, data pipelines and internal

tools for product teams. Comfortable owning features end to end, from database schema to

deployment and monitoring.

Skill Inventory

Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL, PostgreSQL, Pandas, NumPy, Docker, Git, Linux, Redis, Celery,

pytest, and CI pipelines. Also experienced with basic machine learning workflows using scikit-

learn.

Professional Journey

Software Developer at Nexwave Systems, Pune, from June 2023 to present. Data Analyst at

BrightMetrics, Mumbai, from July 2021 to May 2023, working on reporting automation and

dashboards.

Role Contributions

Designed and maintained REST services used by five internal teams, reviewed code, mentored two

junior developers, automated weekly data quality checks, and documented deployment runbooks.

Learning Journey

Master of Computer Applications from Savitri Institute of Technology, Pune, completed in 2021.

Bachelor of Computer Applications from City College, Nashik, completed in 2019.

Build Showcase

Invoice Parser: OCR plus FastAPI service that extracts fields from vendor invoices. Stock

Watch: a small alerting tool that tracks price movements and emails a daily digest to

subscribers.

Credential Vault

AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, earned in 2024. Google Data Analytics Certificate, completed

in 2023, along with an internal Docker and Kubernetes training programme.
